the addition of yeast to a dairy ration can increase milk production, and the addition of tallow or whole cottonseed to a ration containing corn silage can depress production.

the addition of cottonseed hulls to corn silage is a positive strategy for improving the SCM of dairy cows.
the addition of cottonseed hulls to corn silage diets increased milk production and SCM, whereas whole cottonseed decreased milk yield.

cottonseed hulls can be used as a forage substitute for dairy cows.
cottonseed by-products are useful forage supplements, but the effects of whole cottonseed on milk production are negative.
